           node-version: 22
           cache: pnpm
       - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
+      # Refuse to publish when the pushed tag and package.json disagree.
+      # Tags are created by hand, and a tag on the wrong commit would
+      # publish whatever version that commit happens to carry.
+      - name: Check the tag against package.json
+        id: version
+        env:
+          TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
+        run: |
+          expected="v$(node -p "require('./package.json').version")"
+          echo "expected=${expected}" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
+          if [ "$TAG" != "$expected" ]; then
+            echo "::error::tag ${TAG} does not match package.json (${expected})"
+            exit 1
+          fi
+      # Only tags on main are released. A tag on a feature branch fails
+      # here instead of publishing a version nobody reviewed.
+      - name: Check the tagged commit is on main
+        run: |
+          git fetch --no-tags origin main
+          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$GITHUB_SHA" origin/main; then
+            echo "::error::${GITHUB_SHA} is not on main"
+            exit 1
+          fi
+      - name: Summarise the release
+        env:
+          EXPECTED: ${{ steps.version.outputs.expected }}
+        run: |
+          {
+            echo "### Releasing ${EXPECTED}"
+            echo "Commit: ${GITHUB_SHA}"
+          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
       - run: pnpm build
       - run: pnpm publish --no-git-checks
